shellCommands.command:
node server.js & sleep 1
echo "--- add books:"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Great pacing."}'
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Neuromancer","author":"William Gibson"}'
echo; echo "--- validation:"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -d '{"title":""}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
echo; echo "--- list:"
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books

node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Great pacing."}'
ID=$(curl -s localhost:3000/api/books | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(d)[0].id))')
echo; echo "--- mark finished ($ID):"
curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3000/api/books/$ID -d '{"status":"finished"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
echo; echo "--- single book (share link target):"
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books/$ID
echo; echo "--- share URL serves app:"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{content_type}\n" localhost:3000/book/$ID
echo "--- 404 book api:"
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books/nope
echo; echo "--- assets:"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{content_type}\n" localhost:3000/assets/app.js
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{content_type}\n" localhost:3000/

pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.5
node server.js & sleep 1
echo "--- assets after fix:"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{content_type}\n" localhost:3000/assets/app.js
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{content_type}\n" localhost:3000/assets/style.css
echo "--- persisted after restart:"
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books
echo; echo "--- data file:"
cat data/books.json
pkill -f "node server.js"

(node server.js > server.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "app.js: %{http_code} %{content_type}\n" localhost:3000/assets/app.js
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "style.css: %{http_code} %{content_type}\n" localhost:3000/assets/style.css
echo "--- persisted after restart:"
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books; echo
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.3; rm -rf data server.log; ls -R public && ls
pgrep -f "node server.js" || echo "server stopped"; ls; ls public
pkill -xf "node server.js"; sleep 0.3; pgrep -xf "node server.js" || echo stopped; rm -rf data server.log; ls
